What an amazing experience! These two people are incredible and you can trust them completely. They made the whole process so easy, comfortable, and special. What impressed me most is that even after bringing my precious Romeo home, she continues to check on us, asking how we are. It's not just about selling puppies; they genuinely love them and care about them going to loving homes. After waiting for over a year for the puppy of my dreams, God put these wonderful people in my path. I recommend them 1,000%! Thank you for making my dream come true and bringing my four-legged baby into my life 🐾🩵

An excellent experience from beginning to end! From the first moment we contacted them, we received incredibly kind, professional, and attentive service. The entire process was clear, organized, and filled with confidence.

The delivery of our puppy was perfect, and the care and love with which he was treated was evident. Furthermore, something we greatly appreciated was the continued contact and attention after the delivery, with them always checking on him and answering any questions we might have.

We are so happy with our newest member of the family and grateful for all the care and dedication throughout the entire process. ❤️🐶

We wholeheartedly recommend Nessys Puppies! Thank you for making the whole experience so special!
Nessy’s Puppies was great! I highly recommend them if you are trying to purchase a dog.

I will never regret contacting these wonderful people to adopt my little four-legged friend 🥰
"My experience with this company couldn't have been better. From day one, they explained everything with absolute clarity and provided impeccable service. My dog ​​arrived from Miami to Nebraska in excellent condition, super healthy and happy. They took care of every detail for her trip, including her food and even a very cute blanket. What I value most is their ongoing commitment; they keep calling to check on her and making sure she's doing well. They are trustworthy professionals, and I recommend them without hesitation."

My experience with Nessyspuppies was excellent; they were always attentive to everything I needed with my puppy. We adopted a super beautiful, very healthy, and well-cared-for Maltese. I recommend them 100%.
Excellent service, very attentive and professional, 100% recommended

If you're looking for unconditional love and haven't had the chance to adopt, there's also Nessy's Puppies. There, you'll find a team of responsible, serious, committed, and passionate people dedicated to the well-being of your new family member—and yours too! Feel free to contact them for an appointment, and I assure you, you won't regret it. They are completely trustworthy and willing to help you in any way they can to find that special puppy you've always dreamed of. I'm blessed to have three incredibly beautiful, healthy Pomeranians from Nessy's Puppies, all free of any genetic problems. Thank God, we are a complete and very happy family.
I thank God for putting them in my path so I could surprise my children. They are super kind and reliable. I recommend them 100%. Thank you and God bless you.
Excellent experience! 🐾💕 My dog ​​arrived beautiful, healthy, and very well cared for. They were very attentive and professional throughout the entire process. I recommend them 100%! …

Thank you for making the whole process so wonderful and special. I would definitely recommend you and would trust you again! 🥰🐾

I couldn't be more grateful to this company for all the support and professionalism they showed our Mila 🐶🤍

Just a few days after we got her, Mila developed a gastrointestinal problem related to parasites, and from the very first moment, they were there, attentive, and took full responsibility for everything until she was completely recovered.

They covered the veterinary expenses, provided constant follow-up, and demonstrated something that is incredibly valuable these days: honesty, commitment, and genuine love for animals.

They are definitely serious, professional, and compassionate people. Thank you for the peace of mind, attention, and care with which you handled the entire situation. Mila is happy and healthy today, and that's also thanks to you ✨

I recommend them with complete confidence 💕
They are very nice and professionals , I adopted a Yorkie 3 months old, healthy, beautiful, happy puppy, they delivered from Miami to NYC. THank You very much.
